A juror that skips cases loses 7% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the sonnet fee to keep them eligible. A 405 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
